parameters.content:
## BriefPilot Pro
Daily owner command brief built from leads, invoices, reminders, and quotes. Produces max 3 actions, saves to Supabase, sends WhatsApp, and exports to Sheets. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID and connect WhatsApp before publishing.

nodes.name: Export Brief to Sheet (disabled)
nodes.notes: Placeholder export. Disabled so it cannot break the run. Add your Google Sheet document + tab, then enable.

nodes.name: Send Owner Brief
nodes.notes: The brief was previously saved to Supabase and never delivered. Business-initiated WhatsApp messages need an approved template unless the owner messaged the business number in the last 24 hours.
